details:
- CVE-2026-53790: refuse a shell-active RSYNC_CONNECT_PROG %H host and
  quote it; escape backtick, newline and carriage return in remote-shell
  arguments
- CVE-2026-53793: confine a "/./" inner-module chroot: secure
  opens, change_dir, chmod, rename, delta-basis opens and alt-dest basis
  stats, resolved with an in-tree-symlink-following walk so in-module
  symlinks and --link-dest=../dir keep working; also sanitize a
  fuzzy-basis xname on the client
- CVE-2026-70453: cap the per-offset hash_search() chain walk at
  MAX_CHAIN_LEN
- CVE-2026-70458: refuse FLAG_HLINKED without -H or on a directory, and
  skip the checksum basis match for a non-regular hard-linked entry
- CVE-2026-70464: bound the daemon's pre-transfer handshake reads with an
  absolute deadline and cap daemon argument lists
- CVE-2026-29518: rebuild the module-relative path for the daemon
  sender's confined open, fixing "file has vanished" for a file fetched
  by name from a subdirectory of a "use chroot = no" module
